races.paceDynamic: Soir De Garde will dictate proceedings from the front in this small field, with only Ndaawi and Therellbguddaysyet likely to race prominently behind the leader. The lack of early pace pressure means Soir De Garde can control fractions and kick for home when ready. With five of seven runners preferring to hold up (Absurde, Sageborough, No Looking Back, Busselton), they'll rely on a sustained finish over the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical pace who can position close to Soir De Garde and avoid getting caught in traffic behind the wall of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Soir De Garde maintains an uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The leader can time his effort perfectly while the hold-up brigade get squeezed for room in the straight. Prominent runners like Ndaawi can track the pace and pounce when the moment arrives.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely steady and the hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: Class tells as Absurde and the better-rated hold-up horses unleash powerful finishes. The front runners pay for their early exertions over the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Ndaawi or Therellbguddaysyet press Soir De Garde early and soften him up
scenarios.body: The pace battle weakens the leader allowing a prominent runner to slip through and time their challenge perfectly. Hold-up horses still need luck in running from their poor draws.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Profits
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites get involved in pace battles or encounter trouble in running
scenarios.body: An unfancied runner like Sageborough or No Looking Back finds the gaps that matter. Sometimes small fields and tactical races throw up surprise results when the market leaders cancel each other out.

races.paceDynamic: Kimi De Mai is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a sustainable tempo without pressure. With most others (Poetic Twist, Crystal Gold, Somersby Roost, Courtmac Gesture) adopting prominent positions, they'll track Kimi De Mai closely in the first half. The hold-up horses (Dictionary Corner, Tountinna, Ardeen Joy, Wings Of Africa, Toor Idaho, Questionable, Quiet In Bresil) face a tactical disadvantage with limited early pace to sit behind. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the leader and strike when Kimi De Mai weakens, rather than hold-up horses who need stronger gallop to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Kimi De Mai sets steady fractions and the prominent horses get perfect positioning
scenarios.body: The trackers will have ideal stalking positions to pounce when Kimi De Mai weakens after the last hurdle. Crystal Gold and Poetic Twist possess the class and tactical speed to capitalize from their prominent berths.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Kimi Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Kimi De Mai maintains her gallop longer than expected under Harry Cobden's patient ride
scenarios.body: The Mullins-trained mare's experience and tactical positioning will prove decisive as others struggle to reel her in. Her recent third-place finishes suggest she's primed to finally convert.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes stronger than expected or Kimi De Mai goes too fast
scenarios.body: Dictionary Corner or Tountinna will benefit from increased gallop that sets up their closing kicks. The hold-up runners need this scenario to have any realistic winning chance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or several prominent runners make jumping errors
scenarios.body: Lower-rated horses like Somersby Roost or Courtmac Gesture could sneak through when the fancied runners falter. This requires multiple things to go wrong for the market leaders.

races.paceDynamic: Sainte Lucie and Cappa Hill will contest the early lead, with Sainte Lucie likely to dictate from the front given her more aggressive style. Eight prominent racers including Its Bilbo, Coyote Spirit, and Monbeg Park will create significant congestion behind the leaders, setting up a honest gallop but potential traffic problems approaching the final two flights. The hold-up horses like County Final, I'm Slippy, and Open Secret will need clear runs in the closing stages. This pace setup strongly favours the front-runners and early prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic jam behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Sainte Lucie or Cappa Hill gets an uncontested lead and avoids the prominent pack squeeze.
scenarios.body: The winner escapes the traffic chaos by being clear of it from the start, maintaining rhythm over the final two flights while others struggle for room. This rewards pure speed and jumping fluency over tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the eight prominent runners manage to avoid serious traffic problems and one breaks clear 2 out.
scenarios.body: A horse like Its Bilbo or Coyote Spirit times their move perfectly between the tiring leaders and the still-traveling hold-up horses. Superior fitness and tactical speed decides it in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If County Final or Open Secret gets a dream run through gaps that open late.
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final half-mile and a closer with the right turn of foot picks off tired horses who've been racing prominently throughout. Class and finishing kick trumps early position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Helps Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or a bunched finish allows an unfancied horse to sneak through.
scenarios.body: Complete traffic mayhem means the winner is simply the horse that stays out of trouble rather than the best horse on form. An each-way outsider capitalizes on others' misfortune.

races.paceDynamic: Onlymammycanloveme looks the sole committed front-runner with his prominent style and recent form showing early positions, likely to set a measured gallop over this stamina test. The lack of genuine pace pressure means he can dictate terms, with prominent runners like West Cork Wildway, Toor Khov and Sarandon sitting handy but unlikely to challenge for the lead early. This creates a tactical race where the large contingent of hold-up horses including Getaway Charlie, Jeriko De Baune, Themanintheanorak and West Is Awake will be relying on a strong finish from off the pace. The race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems and capitalise on the likely moderate early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Onlymammycanloveme gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina reserves
scenarios.body: He can kick clear approaching the final flight with the field strung out behind struggling to make up ground. The hold-up horses face too much to do having given the winner too much rope in the early stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can track Onlymammycanloveme and outstay him in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The pace-setter weakens in the final half-mile allowing a well-positioned tracker to assert with superior stamina. West Cork Wildway or Toor Khov are ideally placed to capitalise on this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the hold-up horses get clear runs in the straight
scenarios.body: A strong finisher can sweep past tired leaders with a sustained late charge over the final three flights. Getaway Charlie or Jeriko De Baune could benefit from their patient tactics paying dividends.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the ground rides softer than expected and multiple horses fail to see out the trip
scenarios.body: The race falls apart in the final half-mile with several fancied runners stopping, allowing an outsider with proven stamina to emerge from the pack. One And Only or West Clare could profit from others' misfortune.

races.paceDynamic: Classic Getaway will likely set the early tempo from the front, with Broomfield Bijou, Promontory, and potentially others tracking closely given their prominent tendencies. The pace should be manageable early over this 3m½f trip, but the Grade 3 nature and small field size means it won't be dawdling. Nowwhatdoyouthink sits as the sole hold-up runner and will rely on others to create the gallop. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can travel well and kick off the pace, as there's insufficient early speed to set up a truly strong gallop for the hold-up horse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Measured Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Classic Getaway sets a controlled tempo and the race becomes tactical
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last fence with positioning crucial. Prominent runners with tactical speed hold all the aces in this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners push Classic Getaway along and create genuine pace
scenarios.body: The sustained tempo stretches the field and favours those with stamina reserves. Hold-up tactics become more viable with a truer test of staying power.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Classic Getaway gets his own way in front and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The leader uses his class advantage to dictate from pillar to post. The chasing pack struggles to peg back the front-runner's advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse and Rebuild
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and becomes stop-start through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically before a mad scramble develops. Raw ability trumps positioning in a messy finish.

races.paceDynamic: Wingmen appears the only confirmed pace-setter in this beginners' chase field, with most others showing prominent tendencies rather than true front-running styles. This creates a potentially uncontested lead situation where Wingmen can dictate terms without serious early pressure. The likely scenario sees a steady pace through the early stages with the prominent runners like Funiculi Funicula, Mister Pink and Scalpnagoon tracking behind, before the race develops from 3 out. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, as they'll have first run on the lone hold-up horse Ocastle Des Mottes while not having to do the donkey work that Wingmen faces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Wingmen gets an easy lead and the pace stays steady throughout
scenarios.body: Wingmen faces no early pressure and can time his effort perfectly, while the prominent pack fails to organise a strong enough challenge. The 8-year-old's class advantage tells when he quickens approaching the last.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners mount a coordinated challenge from 3 out
scenarios.body: Funiculi Funicula and Mister Pink close strongly on Wingmen's outside, with the Mullins runner's superior recent form proving decisive. Wingmen pays for doing the early work when challenged by fresher legs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and the field comes back to Ocastle Des Mottes
scenarios.body: The prominent runners go too hard trying to reel in Wingmen, allowing Ocastle Des Mottes to pick up the pieces with his trademark late run. The Mullins second string benefits from patient tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Wingmen goes too slow and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: A crawling pace means stamina becomes irrelevant and it turns into a sprint finish where any of the prominent runners can win. The freshest horse on the day prevails in a blanket finish.
